# pulsar_package (Resource)

Manages Pulsar packages and metadata for functions, sources, and sinks. The local `path` must exist during plan and apply.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Package name.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace that owns the package.
- `path` (String) Local path to the package archive. Changing the file contents will trigger an update.
- `tenant` (String) Tenant that owns the package.
- `type` (String) Package type. Supported values: `function`, `sink`, `source`.
- `version` (String) Package version. Changing the version creates a new package resource.

### Optional

- `contact` (String) Contact information stored in Pulsar metadata.
- `description` (String) Optional package description stored in Pulsar metadata.
- `properties` (Map of String) Additional metadata properties.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (Number) Server-side package creation timestamp (epoch millis).
- `file_checksum` (String) Checksum reported by Pulsar for the uploaded package.
- `file_name` (String) Package file name stored in metadata.
- `file_size` (Number) Package size reported by Pulsar (in bytes).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `modification_time` (Number) Server-side package modification timestamp (epoch millis).
- `package_url` (String) Fully-qualified package URL in the format `<type>://<tenant>/<namespace>/<name>@<version>`.
- `source_hash` (String) SHA256 checksum of the local package file. Used to detect file changes.

## Import

```shell
terraform import pulsar_package.example function://public/default/example@1.0.0
```
